furnishing.body: A copy of your page held on the server nearest the visitor, so it arrives without a round trip to the origin.

examples.label: Order details definition list

<.component component_name="chelekom-dl" site="Global" id="order-details" class="max-w-sm rounded-lg border border-neutral-200 p-5 dark:border-neutral-700">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-dt" site="Global" size="small" class="opacity-60">Order number</.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-dd" site="Global" id="order-number" class="mb-3">NW-48213</.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-dt" site="Global" size="small" class="opacity-60">Placed</.component>

examples.label: Glossary entry in a documentation page
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-dl" site="Global" id="glossary-edge-cache" class="max-w-md">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-dt" site="Global">Edge cache</.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-dd" site="Global" id="glossary-edge-cache-definition" size="small" class="mt-1 opacity-80">
    A copy of your page held on the server nearest the visitor. It is served straight from there, so the origin is never asked twice for the same thing.
  </.component>
</.component>
